messages:
alex: Hey team, first week here! trying to set up local env and hit a 403 when calling vault.redwood.ai to read secrets. any quick checklist for new hires? :wave:

noah: welcome @alex! did you complete the onboarding SSO group step? that often blocks vault access.

alex: yep SSO done. i can access most internal docs, just the secrets endpoint fails.

devex: hi @alex 5b welcome. quick steps: 1) file a dev-secrets request at https://secrets.redwood.internal/request using the "onboard-dev" template, 2) attach manager approval (a screenshot or short note), 3) grant is automatic once approved. we also have a CLI helper: `rwdx onbaord secrets` (typo-intentional alias) — jk, use `rwdx secrets auth login` to verify after approval.

security-bot: Reminder: Dev credentials expire by default after 8h. For CI use KMS-wrapped env vars: format `MYKEY: kms:alias/redwood/ci`.

tara: FYI: for repo secrets in CI we prefer repo-level KMS aliases, not account-wide keys. ping me with the repo name and i'll add the KMS alias and a deploy role.

alex: thanks! one more: what about rotating service creds? do owners do it or is it automatic?

noah: rotation rules: app secrets 90 days (owner-managed), KMS keys auto-rotate yearly by default unless marked stable. emergency rotates are coordinated by security after an incident ticket. we post a blameless heads-up and a migration window.

devex: if you need temporary DB creds for local work use our DB short-lived user flow: `rwdx db temp-user --role dev --ttl 3h` returns JSON you can `export` into your shell. this avoids storing long-lived strings.

alex: perfect. i'll open the request now. tagging @tara to follow-up on repo KMS if i hit infra stuff. thanks all! :thumbsup:
